title: Incorporating admiral
text: workflow inspired portions admiral vignette.
code: ## ```yaml ## meta: ##   ID: ADVS ##   Type: ADAM ##   Description: Create Basic ADVS ##   Priority: 1 ## spec: ##   SDTM_DM: ##     _all: ##       required: true ##   SDTM_VS: ##     _all: ##       required: true ## steps: ##   - output: initial_advs ##     name: admiral::derive_vars_merged ##     params: ##       dataset: SDTM_VS ##       dataset_add: SDTM_DM ##       new_vars: !expr exprs(TRT01A) ##       by_vars: !expr exprs(STUDYID, USUBJID) ##   - output: advs ##     name: dplyr::mutate ##     params: ##       .data: initial_advs ##       PARAMCD: !expr rlang::expr(.data[["VSTESTCD"]]) ##       AVAL: !expr rlang::expr(.data[["VSORRES"]]) ##   - output: advs ##     name: admiral::derive_param_map ##     params: ##       dataset: advs ##       by_vars: !expr exprs(STUDYID, USUBJID, TRT01A, VSDTC, VISIT, VISITNUM, VSTPT, VSTPTNUM) ##       sysbp_code: 'SYSBP' ##       diabp_code: 'DIABP' ##       get_unit_expr: !expr rlang::expr(.data[["VSORRESU"]]) ## ``` ADAM_workflows <- workr::MakeWorkflowList(   strNames = "ADVS",   strPath = "demo_gsmpharmaverse/workflows/2_SDTM_TO_ADAM/",   strPackage = "workr" ) ADAM <- workr::RunWorkflows(lWorkflows = ADAM_workflows, lData = sdtm) map2(ADAM, names(ADAM), function(x,y) arrow::write_parquet(x, paste0("demo_gsmpharmaverse/data/ADAM/",y,".parquet"))

title: Workflow Execution Helpers
text: {workr} provides minimal mental model describing executing data workflows: Workflows YAML files meta (workflow metadata) steps (ordered list function calls) Steps functions accept data parameters, producing output gets added shared data list Meta workflow-level configuration accessible steps package provides three core functions: RunStep() - execute single workflow step RunWorkflow() - execute workflow specification (YAML) RunWorkflows() - run multiple workflows sequence

title: Workflow Execution Helpers
text: {workr} built solve specific problem: reusable, customizable data pipelines complex clinical trial monitoring. core functions {workr} originally developed part {gsm} framework risk-based quality montoring (RBQM). {gsm} team developed stable, reusable model generating metrics monitor clinical trials. challenge figuring run metrics across large portfolio; Take 30 studies monthly snapshots, needing 15 metrics computed 5 steps get 27,000 computations per year. make things complex, study slightly different requirements, maintaining individual scripts quickly becomes massive pain. {workr}’s solution: Define workflows , customize via meta parameters, compose larger pipelines. original gsm::RunWorkflow functions developed hours, seen stopgap picked “real” pipeline, approach proven suprisingly stable flexible. much , ’ve created {workr} started using outside {gsm} pipelines.

title: Workflow Execution Helpers
text: Define workflow YAML: Run R:
code: # hello_cars.yaml meta:   ID: hello_cars   col: speed steps:   - name: dplyr::pull      output: speed     params:       df: df       col: col   - name: mean     output: result     params:       lData: speed wf <- yaml::read_yaml("hello_cars.yaml") lData <- list(df = cars)  result <- workr::RunWorkflow(   lWorkflow = wf,   lData = lData )  # result = 15.4 (mean of cars$speed)

title: Workflow Execution Helpers
text: step workflow: Calls function (specified step$name) Passes parameters params (resolving references lData, meta, literal values) Saves result lData using output name Makes available next step chaining steps (even whole workflows) together, can build complex pipelines simple, reusable components.

text: Runs single step assessment workflow. function called RunWorkflow step workflow. prepares parameters function call calls function specified lStep$name prepared parameters. primary utility function provide prioritized parser function parameterization. Parameters specified named list lStep$params, element key-value pair parsed passed specified function set parameter names/values. Parameter values specified scalar strings. values pulled lMeta lData possible. matching lData lMeta objects found, parameter values passed strings. Note parsing vectorized parameters supported time; passed directly character vectors. pass vector list, recommend saving object lData. Full prioritization parsing parameters : single parameter value equal "lMeta", full lMeta object passed function (given paramName). single parameter value equal "lData", full lData object passed function. single parameter value equal "lSpec", full lSpec object passed function. single parameter value found names(lMeta), property pulled lMeta (e.g. lMeta{paramVal}) passed function. single parameter value found names(lData), property pulled lData (e.g. lData{paramVal}) passed function.
